title: Purpose-separated A-signed exact two-member B authority (draft)
description: Ed25519 signs ASCII purpose agent-bot/stage2a-b-member-authority/v1, one NUL byte and exact RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 payload bytes. B verifies this and the member-set assignment against its independently opened fixed root-owned A public-key pin before bind. An issuer field inside this envelope is never a trust anchor by itself.
